name: Kurushima Michiya
source:
A former professor at Tokyo University. [Spoiler]Acted as the center chief at Ikebukuro CPC for 14 years.[/spoiler] 

An expert in cognitive ethology, neuroscience, and brain science.

Considered a prodigy during his time in the Busujima Laboratory.

Most well-known for his New Generation Influencer Hypothesis.

[Spoiler]So great was his love for [url=/c165799]Aso Yukari[/url] that he transferred her consciousness into a Humanoid Operating Machine after her untimely death. Thus [url=/c85766]Sori Ayuka[/url] came to be.[/spoiler]

[From the in-game profile]
